chrome.gamingLocked: The mode can’t change while a connection is open
chrome.splitToggle: Split the screen / leave split mode
split.title: How should the screen split?
split.sub: Each pane runs an independent session — to the same or different hosts.
split.subRemote: Each pane is an independent remote-desktop session — to the same or different hosts.
split.subGame: Each pane is an independent game-stream session — to the same or different hosts.
split.joinPrompt: Press A / ✕ on a controller to join pane {n}
input.assignDesc: Lock each keyboard/mouse/controller to a pane — separate players use separate gear (couch co-op). An unlocked device follows the focused pane.
split.modeGameHint: Host launches the app and captures its window
split.modeWindowHint: Pick an open window on the host
split.windowNeedsSession: Window capture needs a session already connected to this host
tab.dragHint: Drag outside the window to detach, onto the session area to split
tab.groupHint: Split screen — click to show, drag to move them all
connErr.relayDown: Could not reach the relay server — check your internet connection and the relay setting.
connErr.peerUnreachable: Device could not be reached — it may be offline, or the ID is wrong.
connErr.notOnline: You are not online yet — go online first.
connErr.p2pFailed: Direct connection failed and relay use is disabled (see Network settings).
connErr.unreachable: Could not connect to the target — check the address and your network.
connErr.timeout: Connection timed out — the handshake did not complete in time. The device may be offline or unreachable.
connErr.hostSilent: The host stopped responding. Pulsar on the host may be stuck (graphics card / screen capture) — try restarting it there.
connErr.incompatibleVersion: Relay requires a newer version — please update Pulsar.
relayAuth.failed: Relay authentication failed — wrong password or 2FA code.
host.chatEmpty: Messages from connected devices show up here.
pw.title: Host password
pw.lead: Enter the one-time password shown on the host — or the host can approve without a password by clicking Allow.
pw.totpLead: This device has two-factor authentication on. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
home.title: Connect
home.sub: Share your ID or connect to a remote device.
home.idOrIp: Enter an ID, IP or address · e.g. 192.168.1.42 or pc.example.com:3005
home.unattendedWarn: The one-time password is disabled. Anyone who can reach this PC’s ID can connect without approval.
home.help: This ID is assigned by the relay server. If you share it, others can connect to your device; the link is made over P2P first, falling back to the relay if needed. The password is renewed after every session.
home.noHostGames: No games published on the host (or the host is offline).
home.unknown: Status unknown (not seen on this LAN)
home.noRecents: No connections yet. They appear here once you connect to an ID.
gaming.title: Connect to a host
gaming.gameKind: the host opens it and streams its window
gaming.noDevices: No saved devices yet. Add one with + or star a card.
gaming.removeConfirm: Remove "{name}" from devices? Its connection history is kept.
gaming.editNeedsKbm: Editing requires a keyboard and mouse
gaming.noRecents: No connections yet. They appear here once you connect to a device.
recent.name: Name
recent.imageHint: Pick an icon or upload a picture
devices.title: Devices
devices.sub: Your address book — saved and recently connected peers.
devices.name: Device name
devices.emptyBody: Once you connect to an ID, or save one with Add device, it shows up here.
devices.lanScanning: Scanning… Pulsar devices on this network appear here.
devices.imageHint: Pick an icon or upload a picture
settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Manage streaming, network and security preferences.
settings.sectionStreamingDesc: Settings that apply on this device when it connects to another one.
settings.subMouseDesc: How the mouse behaves while you control the other side.
settings.subHostVideoDesc: Resolution, frame rate, bitrate and encoder this device sends when it shares its screen.
settings.subHostAudioDesc: Whether audio is sent while sharing, and the audio input.
settings.subPathDesc: Whether devices connect directly or through a relay, and the port used for it.
settings.subRelayDesc: The server that carries traffic when a direct connection can't be made.
settings.subAccessDesc: Who can connect to this device, and with which verification.
settings.subTrustedDesc: Paired devices that connect without a password or approval.
settings.subControlDesc: What the person connecting can do on this device.
settings.subProfileDesc: Language, and the name and picture the other side sees.
settings.subAppDesc: Running in the background, updates and clipboard sharing.
settings.subPadDesc: Waking Pulsar with a controller and sending its input in the background.
settings.subDiagDesc: Logs and version info for bug reports.
settings.subAudioDesc: The quality the host's audio arrives in.
settings.subScreenDesc: What shows on and around the video during a session.
settings.subQualityDesc: Quality, codec and HDR asked of the host; how the picture is decoded and shown.
settings.sectionHostDesc: What this device sends when it shares its screen: resolution, encoder, HDR and audio transmit.
settings.qualityDesc: New sessions start with this profile.
settings.encoderDesc: Pick a hardware encoder; "Software" uses the CPU. "Automatic" picks the best hardware.
settings.decoderDesc: Client-side video decoder. "Software" uses the CPU; "Automatic" picks the best hardware.
settings.coopDesc: Two copies of a game in two panes each get only their own player's input (ProtoInput). Ban risk in online games; use only for local co-op.
settings.coopMissing: Component not installed — put the ProtoInput files in the folder
settings.audioQualityDesc: Automatic: Raw on a local network, otherwise High. Also in the session menu.
settings.mouseSensDesc: When a game grabs the mouse, motion is scaled by this. 1× = the mouse's own speed.
settings.pointerFreeDesc: Leaving the video gives control back to this PC; entering it takes control again. Remote desktop only.
settings.darkThemeDesc: Shows the app in dark colours.
settings.autostartDesc: Pulsar starts by itself when you sign in.
settings.autostartBgDesc: Starts in the tray without opening a window; click its icon to open it.
settings.duplicateSessionsDesc: Connecting to a device again opens another session instead of switching to the open one (e.g. the same PC in two tabs).
settings.upscaleDesc: Sharpens a lower-resolution picture as it is scaled up; only acts while the picture is enlarged (e.g. when a slow link lowers the resolution). Auto: the NVIDIA RTX / Intel GPU's AI upscaler (Windows), else AMD FSR.
settings.hostCursorDesc: While the person at the host uses their own mouse, their pointer is marked «Host» and yours shows separately. Remote desktop only.
settings.framePacingDesc: Buffers 1-2 frames and shows them evenly; less judder, a bit more latency. Linux.
settings.preOptimize: Optimize the stream before showing it
settings.preOptimizeDesc: Measures the link for a few seconds and starts at the steadiest quality. Off: picture right away.
settings.audioTransmitDesc: Send this host’s audio to the client (host → client).
settings.audioMuteDesc: The host's speakers stay silent while streaming; audio plays only on the other side. On in game mode.
settings.audioInputDesc: The audio device to capture. Empty = system default.
settings.padWakeDesc: The controller's PS / Xbox button brings Pulsar forward and switches to game mode.
settings.sharedModeDesc: All Windows users on this PC share one Pulsar identity and settings. Changing it needs admin rights and a restart.
shared.standby: This PC’s Pulsar is hosting from another user’s session
shared.standbyUser: This PC’s Pulsar is hosting from {user}’s session
shared.noAccess: Shared Pulsar is on but this Pulsar isn’t running as administrator; start it as administrator to host
shared.needAdmin: Start Pulsar as administrator to change this setting
shared.failed: Couldn’t change the shared Pulsar setting
settings.padBackgroundDesc: The controller keeps driving the remote PC while another app is in front.
settings.gamingSub: Gaming mode is client-only: only the settings used when connecting are shown here. Normal-mode settings (host, security) may differ.
settings.gamingAllSub: Showing all settings; host and security settings are shared with normal mode.
settings.displayNameDesc: The name shown to the other side when you connect.
settings.avatarNone: No image is sent to peers
settings.avatarDesc: How you present yourself to peers: account photo, desktop wallpaper, or anonymous.
controllers.title: Controllers
controllers.reorderHint: Use the arrows to change the player slot order.
controllers.bothModes: Controllers are forwarded in both remote desktop and game streaming sessions.
host.viewOnlyDesc: Stop / allow this client controlling — its input is ignored while the stream keeps running.
settings.nodePortDesc: Listening port for P2P. Empty = random; set one for port forwarding.
settings.connMethodDesc: Recommended: Automatic. Pulsar tries direct P2P first and falls back to the relay if that fails.
toast.reveal: Click to show it in its folder
settings.portMapping: Open a port on the router (UPnP / NAT-PMP)
settings.portMappingDesc: Opens the UDP port on the router automatically; some routers need it for P2P.
settings.relayDesc: Your device ID is issued here, and traffic flows through it when P2P can’t be established.
settings.unattendedDesc: No approval and no password: anyone who knows the device ID can connect.
settings.twofaDesc: Also ask password or unattended connections for an authenticator code. Not asked when you approve.
settings.twofaScan: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password…).
settings.twofaManual: Can't scan it? Enter this code by hand:
settings.twofaEnter: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows:
settings.twofaWrong: That code didn't match. Enter the app's current code (and check that the clocks are right).
settings.connectPwDesc: Anyone with this password connects without approval. Wrong attempts are rate-limited.
settings.requestAdminDesc: Lets a session control elevated windows (Task Manager, installers) when hosting. Needs a restart.
settings.remoteCursorDesc: When the person connecting can't control, their cursor shows on your screen with their name.
settings.trayDesc: Stay in the tray in the background when closed.
settings.clipboardSyncDesc: Copied text is shared both ways with connected devices.
settings.debugDesc: Show the connection activity log on the home page (debugging).
settings.uiHwaccelDesc: Draws Pulsar's own UI on the GPU (not the video stream). Off on Orange Pi 5. Needs a restart.
settings.logsDesc: The log is written to a file on every start (kept 7 days). Attach it to bug reports.
settings.streamDefaultsDesc: Resolution, frame rate and bit rate used when this device hosts a stream.
games.title: Games
games.sub: Games/programs to stream from the host.
games.emptyBody: Add a game/program with Add game, or scan a folder below.
games.fCoopProfile: Co-op: separate save folder for each extra copy
games.scanNeedFolder: Add a folder to scan first.
connecting.slowHint: Taking longer than expected — the host may be offline, or a firewall may be blocking the connection.
session.videoErr: Could not establish the video connection.
session.streamStopped: Stream stopped — the host may have stopped screen sharing.
session.noVideo: No video yet — the host may have failed to start its encoder (on the host try Settings → Encoder: Software).
session.noDecode: Data is arriving but cannot be decoded — this device’s decoder rejected the stream; try another codec.
session.waiting: The host is preparing the video — approve the screen-share permission.
session.av1Native: AV1 isn’t supported in the in-app viewer yet — enable the native viewer (settings) or pick H.264/H.265.
session.controlOffSame: Control disabled on the same device · use a second device for remote control
settings.overlayButtonDesc: Always-visible Pulsar button over the video that opens the overlay menu.
settings.statsHudDesc: Keep the performance stats in the video corner even while the overlay is closed.
settings.statusBarDesc: Shows connection facts under the video; never covers it.
settings.statusBarMenuDesc: The Pulsar menu button sits in the status bar instead of on the video.
settings.statusBarFullscreenDesc: When off, the bar hides in fullscreen and the video fills the whole screen.
settings.statusButtonsDesc: One-click audio toggles in the bar; the same switches as the session menu.
status.btnName.speaker: Remote audio
status.btn.speakerOn: Remote audio on (click to turn off)
status.btn.speakerOff: Remote audio off (click to turn on)
status.btn.micOn: Your microphone is on (click to turn off)
status.btn.micOff: Your microphone is off (click to turn on)
status.btn.hostPlays: The host's speakers play (click to mute)
status.btn.hostMuted: The host's speakers are muted (click to unmute)
session.clickToControl: Click the screen to take control
session.nativeActive: Playing in the native viewer (fullscreen) · exit: Ctrl+Shift+F11
session.nativeClickToControl: Click the video to take control · end: Ctrl+Shift+Q
session.nativeControlling: In control · release: 3×RightCtrl · end: Ctrl+Shift+Q · fullscreen: Ctrl+Shift+F11
session.fileTooBig: File is too large (50 MB max).
files.windowTitle: File manager — tied to this session
session.chatEmpty: No messages yet. Say hi first.
overlay.title: Game menu
overlay.resume: Click the screen or press Ctrl+Shift+M to resume
approve.title: Connection request
approve.lead: A device wants to connect to this computer.
approve.pwNone: You can approve without a password, or wait for one
settings.autoUpdateDesc: Installs new versions without asking and restarts. When off, you're asked first.
update.noSelfUpdate: This install can't update itself (package-manager/Flatpak install, or an AppImage launched without FUSE). Update via your package manager, or download the new version from the GitHub Releases page.
update.sessionsClose: Installing restarts Pulsar: {n} open session(s) will be closed.
relayAuth.title: Relay authentication
relayAuth.desc: This relay requires authentication to connect. You only enter it once — the relay issues this device a durable access key.
relayAuth.totpHint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
relayAuth.keyNote: What you type is not stored. The relay returns an access key bound to this device, so you won't be asked again — until the relay server changes its credentials.
settings.localRelay: Run a relay on this device
settings.localRelayDesc: Pulsar runs its own relay. Devices on the same network can use this address:
settings.relayLocalNote: Not used while this device runs its own relay.
settings.connectPwBlocked: Unavailable while unattended access is on: unattended connections skip authentication entirely, so no password is ever asked for.
ds5.enabledDesc: Adaptive triggers, HD haptics, the controller speaker and the light bar reach the remote game. When off, the controller is forwarded as a plain gamepad. Applies from the next connection.
ds5.modesHint: Auto: on, may be turned down on a weak link · On: always on · Off: off.
ds5.speaker: Controller speaker
ds5.headsetDesc: With headphones in the controller, the session audio plays only through them (like a PS5); nothing plays on this device or the controller speaker. Unplug them and audio returns to this device.
ds4.headsetDesc: With headphones in a USB-connected DualShock 4 (v2 or Sony's USB adapter), session audio plays through them. Not yet tried on a real pad.
ds5.autoDegrade: Turn features down automatically on a weak link
ds5.autoDegradeDesc: If Bluetooth can’t keep up, the speaker goes first, then the mic, then HD haptics (vibration falls back to classic rumble), and last the audio to the headset jack stops (it does not move back to this device). They come back one by one once the link recovers. Only features set to “Auto” are turned down.
ds5.jitterDesc: Network buffer for HD haptics and the speaker. Higher means fewer stutters but more delay. Default 64.
devices.passwordHint: Sent automatically on connect; when it matches, no password is asked.
devices.pairDesc: A paired device no longer asks for a password or approval (a 2FA code is still asked if it is on there).
devices.pairBusy: Pairing… the other side may need to approve.
devices.pairUnsupported: The Pulsar version on that device doesn't support pairing.
devices.unpairLocal: Removed here; the other device couldn't be reached. Remove it there too in Settings → Security.
approve.pairLead: This device wants to be trusted permanently. If you allow it, it connects without a password or approval from now on.
approve.pairNote: You can remove it any time in Settings → Security.
settings.pairedDesc: These devices connect without a password or approval (2FA code still asked if on).
settings.pairedRevokeConfirm: Remove the pairing with {name}? It will need a password again next time it connects.
